title.zh: 定积分 · 把小条加回整体
title.en: The Definite Integral · Adding the Strips Back Up

desc.zh: 曲边围成的面积没有公式可套——那就切：把曲线下切成 1、2、4…32 条长方形，左和与右和从两边夹住真值，缝越切越窄；条无限细时两边贴到的那个数就是定积分。而求它有捷径：找到导数是它自己的那个函数，积分与导数就此接头。
desc.en: No formula fits an area under a curve — so slice it: cut the region into 1, 2, 4 … 32 rectangles, let the left and right sums squeeze the true value from both sides, and watch the gap narrow. The number both sides close in on is the definite integral — and there is a shortcut: find the function whose derivative it is, and integration shakes hands with differentiation.
